name: Western Sahara

capital.note: Western Sahara has no capital that both its claimants recognise: Morocco administers Laâyoune as the seat of one of its regions, and the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic, which names Laâyoune its capital, holds Tifariti as its provisional capital and governs from the refugee camps near Tindouf in Algeria.
